text: This program is divided into beginner, intermediate and advanced levels with each level further divided into 3 levels to allow students at similar Chinese levels to be grouped together. Each class consists of 10-18 students. The curriculum focuses on listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills, modern grammar and essay writing. Application Period · April – August 31st for Fall Semester: · October – November 30 for Spring Semester: Tuition · CNY 9,900/person for the first semester, and CNY 9,100/person for each subsequent semester · NOTE : Advance payment of CNY 2,000/person, pays in full when confirmation enrollment, will be account into the total tuition fee and is not refundable after the opening of the semester. Certificate · Students who have completed all the courses and passed all the course examinations will be granted a certificate of completion.
